'''Persid''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in charge of the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in orbit above [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Mission" />
